title: The retract of a derived module cut out by one rank stratum
statement: Let i: Z → Y be a closed immersion of schemes [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-closed-immersion], A=i_*O_Z, and g_* the module direct image [def-sc-direct-image-algebra-derived-category, def-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-direct-image]. Choose D(A) [def-pc-derived-category]. Let r: Z → ℕ be locally constant with strata U_k [def-sc-locally-ranked-exterior-complex], fix q, and let K lie in D(A). There exist L in D(A), ι: L → K and π: K → L with ι≫π=id_L. For any m,k and module F on U_k, if k≠q and H^m(K)≅g_*j_{k,*}F, then H^m(L)=0. For every m,F on U_q and morphism a:g_*j_{q,*}F→H^m(K), one has a≫H^m(π)≫H^m(ι)=a. No concentration hypothesis or finite-image assumption on r is required.

source.place: Tag 00EE; agent-written expansion of steps 1--2 of lem-sc-clopen-rank-strata-homology-lift, as explained in its Lean docstring

proof.text: Apply the module projector theorem to obtain the natural idempotent η with its support identities.

Take a cochain representative P of K through the localization Q. The components η(P^m) form a chain idempotent p. The abelian category of cochain complexes is idempotent complete. Split p into j:R→P and t:P→R, with j≫t=id_R and t≫j=p. Applying Q and transporting through Q(P)≅K gives L, ι and π. This is the existing Mathlib idempotents_split theorem, used inside a completely proved private helper.

Naturality through the cycles inclusion and homology projection proves homologyMap(p,m)=η(H^m(P)). The homologyFunctorFactors isomorphism and naturality transport this identity through Q and the representative isomorphism, giving H^m(π)≫H^m(ι)=η(H^m(K)).

For homology supported on U_k with k≠q, naturality through its support isomorphism gives η(H^m(K))=0. The retract identity on homology then implies id_{H^m(L)}=0. For any map from U_q, naturality and η=id on the source give the required fixed-map identity.

theorem clopenRankStratum_derived_projector
    {Z Y : Scheme.{u}} (i : Z ⟶ Y) [IsClosedImmersion i]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wA} (SheafOfModules.{u}
      (moduleRings (directImageAlgebraSpace i)))]
    (r : LocallyConstant Z ℕ) (q : ℕ)
    (K : DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (directImageAlgebraSpace i)))) :
    ∃ (L : DerivedCategory
        (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (directImageAlgebraSpace i))))
      (ι : L ⟶ K) (π : K ⟶ L),
      ι ≫ π = 𝟙 L ∧
      (∀ (m : ℤ) (k : ℕ)
        (F : (Scheme.Modules.exteriorRankOpen r k).toScheme.Modules),
        k ≠ q → Nonempty ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
          (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (directImageAlgebraSpace i))) m).obj K ≅
          (RingedSpace.moduleDirectImage (toDirectImageAlgebraSpace i)).obj
            ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (Scheme.Modules.exteriorRankOpen r k).ι).obj F)) →
        IsZero ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
          (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (directImageAlgebraSpace i))) m).obj L)) ∧
      (∀ (m : ℤ) (F : (Scheme.Modules.exteriorRankOpen r q).toScheme.Modules)
        (a : (RingedSpace.moduleDirectImage (toDirectImageAlgebraSpace i)).obj
            ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (Scheme.Modules.exteriorRankOpen r q).ι).obj F) ⟶
          (DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
            (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (directImageAlgebraSpace i))) m).obj K),
        a ≫ (DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
            (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (directImageAlgebraSpace i))) m).map π ≫
          (DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
            (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (directImageAlgebraSpace i))) m).map ι = a)
